messages:
Incident Bot: [ALERT] SLO burn-rate alert triggered for service=/generate, burn_rate=4.2x over 15m window. Paging on-call (priority: paged).
Maya K: saw this come in, I'm on it. looking at graphs now.
Maya K: @Priya can you take customer-facing comms if we need a status note?
Priya R: yep, I can draft an update. do we know if it's real latency or noisy alerts?
Sam T: jumping in — initial tails look like a flurry of small-timeouts from epg-3 clusters, 503s.
Jorge M: adding context: we rolled kernel patch to epg-3 yesterday; could be related.
Maya K: good catch. Sam — can you pull the 1h request histogram and the 4xx/5xx breakdown?
Sam T: grabbing now. quick snippet from dbg:
```
curl -s "https://monitoring/api/query?metric=error_rate&service=generate&window=1h" | jq .
# errors spiked from 0.3% -> 4.5% at 2026-03-05T12:14Z
```
Sam T: looks like a saturated backend on a subset of nodes, increased queueing -> timeouts.
Lina Z: paging thresholds are currently 3x burn over 15m which is noisy for this pattern. we should consider multi-window gating.
Maya K: agree — for this incident we need two things: live mitigation (drain problematic hosts / failover) and post-incident change to alerting so we don't page for transient node-level noise.
Jorge M: I'm running a targeted replacement on epg-3 host set (rolling restart of 6 nodes).
DeployBot: Deploy started: rolling-restart/epg-3 by Jorge M (6 nodes) — ETA ~8m.
Maya K: @Sam can you enable temporary routing-fallback to epg-2 for requests with >200ms p90? command:
```
rgctl route set --service generate --fallback epg-2 --criteria "p90>200ms"
```
Sam T: fallback enabled, monitoring the 5m p90.
Priya R: draft status: "We're investigating increased errors impacting generation calls; traffic is being routed to healthy hosts to mitigate customer impact. No data loss. Updates in ~15m." want me to post? :loudspeaker:
Maya K: yes, post it and add note that we're investigating a rolling restart.
Priya R: posted in #status-page and slack incident channel.
Lina Z: for postmortem: propose alert tuning: require both (a) burn_rate > 3x over 15m AND (b) sustained >2x over 1h OR a 15m burn on >=3 distinct host groups. reduces single-host noise. also add a new dashboard panel for per-host burn heatmap.
Maya K: +1. also add automatic suppression for known maintenance windows and deploys.
Jorge M: restarts finished, error rate falling back to baseline now.
Sam T: confirming p95/p99 stabilized, I see error rate at 0.4% and burn back to 1.0x.
Incident Bot: [RESOLVED] SLO burn alert cleared for /generate at 1902468142.
Maya K: thanks everyone. action items: 1) Lina to file alert-change PR with multi-window gating and host-group requirement, 2) Sam to add host heatmap panel, 3) Priya to update post-incident customer note.
Lina Z: filing PR now: https://git.internal/r/alerts/PR-482 — description includes thresholds and rationale.
Sam T: added dashboard card under "Generate Service" -> "SLO burn per-host".
Priya R: post-incident note posted to customers and support.
Maya K: closing the paging handoff — if anything else pops up tag me. great coordinated run. :thumbsup:
